column2: We know what we must do, and so do the fallen angels. We know, too, that humans are needed for it...{wait}{clear}And we know the place and the role of humans themselves...{wait}{clear}But the fallen angels feel none of the conflict we feel. All they have is desire.{wait}{clear}A desire for boundless power, for dominion and chaos, a desire only to devour all things...{wait}{clear}Sorrow and hatred lead to desire. But we must not give in to that temptation. Neither we, nor humans...{wait}{clear}

Lord Raphael... I'm sorry...{wait}{clear}I was caught up in nothing but the grief of losing someone dear. That changes nothing, does it...?{wait}{clear}If I don't pull myself together now, even more tragedy may come of it...{wait}{clear}

Whatever happens, we must guide the good so that they may walk the right path. That, in turn, will protect everything.{wait}{clear}When you cannot tell what is right, listen closely to the voice of your heart.{wait}{clear}For whose sake... For whose sake do you exist...?{wait}{clear}You already know the answer.{wait}{clear}
...Yes...{wait}{clear}
Now go to the one who grieves. I am sure they are waiting for you.{wait}{clear}
Yes...{wait}{clear}Lord Raphael... thank you.{wait}{clear}
So this... is the Heavenly Dragon.{wait}{clear}
Ngh, I won't let you go any further!{wait}{clear}
The tower is collapsing, Clive!{wait}{clear}
Devil... I'll hunt you to the ends of the earth.{wait}{clear}
...At the end, she let me cut her down on purpose.{wait}{clear}Why...?{wait}{clear}
Hero Clive, Angel ＄＄＄＄＄＄, you have done well.{wait}{clear}
You're leaving?{wait}{clear}
I'm grateful to you...{wait}{clear}
Even someone like me... you stood by me the whole way...{wait}{clear}
No, I'm the one who should be grateful...{wait}{clear}
If you ever come down to the surface again, come see me. Anytime.{wait}{clear}
Until we meet again, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.{wait}{clear}
Yes. Goodbye, Clive! Take care!{wait}{clear}
You're leaving...{wait}{clear}
Yes, but... I'll come back to you. I promise.{wait}{clear}
Even if... even if you can't stay... this isn't the end, is it...?{wait}{clear}
No...{wait}{clear}
...I'll be waiting. For you...{wait}{clear}
Somehow... I feel there's so much I need to tell you...{wait}{clear}
But the words won't come now...{wait}{clear}
Is this... the last time we'll ever meet?{wait}{clear}
...I don't know... I'm sorry.{wait}{clear}
When we meet again... someday...{wait}{clear}
